title: Characterization of algebraic degree bounds
statement: Let $n,r\in\mathbb N$, and let $c$ assign a coefficient in the field with two elements to every subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Its algebraic degree is at most $r$ if and only if every subset with nonzero coefficient has cardinality at most $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ assigns coefficients in the field with two elements to every subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
